title: Ilus
summary: Ilus is named in Cory, Ancient Fragments (1876, ed. Hodges), with a reign length or synchronism. Display only.
description: Added from the Cory import. Display only. Cory gives reign lengths and synchronisms, not a BC year this record can sort on, and no tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year (Cory is display-only and gives none).

reign.note: pending CFAH reference (no CFAH anchor point or Table 1 entry found for this)

reign.date: “In the thirty-second year of his power and reign, Ilus, who is Kronus”
reign.citation: Cory, Ancient Fragments (London: Reeves & Turner, 1876, ed. E. Richmond Hodges), p. 15; Sanchoniathon, ap. Eusebius, Praeparatio evangelica, book 1
reign.note: Sanchoniathon. Not Raleigh's Ilus, and not the Egyptian demigod Kronus of p. 111. The later sentence in which Zeus and Adodus reign by the consent of Kronus gives no length.
